text:
kai (design): dropped tiny prototype: compact settings form + bulk-delete flow. curious on required-field signals and whether inline errors are too noisy for dense lists. https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/compact-settings
ryn (product): nice. quick thought: users in tables scan left-to-right; big inline messages push them off-screen. maybe show an icon + tooltip and only show full message on focus or on submit.
dev (eng): icon+tooltip is cheap. for real-time uniqueness checks we should debounce and show a neutral spinner state, not a red error immediately.
mai (a11y): agree on delayed hard errors. also if using icons, include aria-labels. icon-only indicators must have accessible text and keyboard focus target.
kai (design): proposal: three modes depending on density - dense rows = icon-only with tooltip + aria, mid density = small inline hint, full form = full inline message. will mock all three.
ryn (product): sounds good. what about required markers? small asterisk vs text "(required)" suffix. mobile tightness makes suffix awkward.
mai (a11y): asterisk alone is not enough; add aria-required="true" on inputs. visible hint is better but can be compacted to "(req)" if we document it. ensure screen readers get the same info.
dev (eng): implementation idea: add data attribute data-required="true" and a CSS token switch so we can swap between glyph/suffix without changing DOM.
kai (design): lovely. now delete UX: current pattern shows modal with list of items to delete. typed-confirm is heavy. alternatives: toast-undo, checkbox confirm, or typed-confirm for very large or org-scoped deletes.
ryn (product): prefer toast-undo for <20, checkbox+modal for 20-200, typed-confirm for >200 or when resources are shared. we should measure restore rate.
mai (a11y): typed-confirm can be a barrier; always provide a secondary accessible alternative like a confirm checkbox. and ensure focus moves into the modal and to first interactive element.
dev (eng): toast-undo integrates well if our storage supports soft-delete; typed-confirm needs server-side verification (use stable id not display name).
kai (design): copy suggestions: header: "Delete 8 items referencing connector X" body: "This action will remove these items. You can restore from Trash for 14 days." CTA: "Delete items" (red). avoid vague "Are you sure?"
ryn (product): +1. one more: default button placement should match console pattern (primary right on desktop). call it out in the spec.
ops-bot: design-lint: color-contrast check completed; warn: token --error-red-400 borderline on small text. manual review advised.
kai (design): action items: 1) I'll add three density mocks, 2) include aria hints and tooltip text, 3) prototype toast-undo and checkbox-modal, 4) write 3 microcopy variants. tagging you when ready.
ryn (product): please include small A/B plan: accidental deletes, undo use-rate, time-to-complete forms.
mai (a11y): happy to review a11y notes after mocks. remember keyboard-only users for tooltips.
